name: PLATO MILP Benchmark (MIPLIB2017)
description: Benchmarks mixed-integer linear programming solvers on 240 instances from MIPLIB2017, requiring proof of global optimality within a 2-hour time limit. The benchmark compares commercial and open-source solvers on the full solve process including presolving, cutting planes, and branch-and-bound. Geometric mean times (scaled to best solver) and number of instances solved to optimality are the primary performance metrics.
typical_sota_score: COPT (219/240 solved, scaled mean 1.0); Optverse (210/240, scaled mean 1.72); HiGHS (162/240, scaled mean 7.36).
reputation: The primary MILP solver benchmark by Hans Mittelmann; among the most cited performance comparisons in computational OR.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. Time limit: 2 hours per instance. Hardware: AMD Ryzen 9 5900X (12 cores, 128GB). Preprocessing includes row/column perturbation.
